page.overview:
What is Acamar III?

Acamar III was the inhabited third planet in the Acamar system. This planet was located in a sector of the Beta Quadrant and was approximately 165 light years from Sol. It was the homeworld of the Acamarians, a warp-capable humanoid species.

In 2366, the visited the planet to enlist the aid of Sovereign Marouk to end the Gatherer raids on Federation outposts. Upon completion of this mission, the Enterprise returned the sovereign to her planet.

() This planet's quadrant of origin was inferred based on the position of its star system as seen in the star chart appearing in the episode . "AWK-uh-mar" was the pronunciation for this planet's name from the pronunciation guide.
